title: Module 5 — Weather, plans, health, instructions and recommendations
description: Talk about the weather and future plans, describe how you feel and visit a doctor, follow instructions and give advice, using ir + infinitivo, the imperative and indirect object pronouns.

topics.title: Weather and future plans
topics.brief: Weather, climate and the four seasons (Está a chover, Está frio, no verão); planning a holiday with the near future ir + infinitivo (Vou viajar, Vamos visitar Faro).

topics.title: Health and the body
topics.brief: Body parts, symptoms and a visit to the doctor or pharmacy; the impersonal verb doer (Dói-me a cabeça) and health expressions with estar com / ter + noun (estar com febre, ter tosse).
topics.avoid: past tenses, subjunctive, object pronouns beyond me/te on doer.

topics.title: Instructions, recipes and advice
topics.brief: Imperativo for instructions and advice: informal tu forms and formal você/vocês forms; recommendations and obligation with dever + infinitivo; simple recipe/instruction sequencing (Primeiro…, Depois…, Por fim…).

topics.title: More irregular verbs
topics.brief: Presente do Indicativo of dar, fazer, trazer, pôr, pedir, perder, dormir, contrasted with the regular -ar/-er/-ir patterns and the irregular verbs already known.
topics.known: Module 1 to 4 irregular verbs (ir, ver, ler, sair, ouvir, vir, poder, querer, dizer, saber).

topics.title: Equal comparisons and object pronouns
topics.brief: Comparison of equality tão … como, tanto … como; indirect object pronouns me, te, lhe, nos, vos, lhes; indefinite pronouns algum/nenhum, alguém/ninguém, tudo/nada.
topics.avoid: past tenses, subjunctive, direct object pronouns (o/a/os/as).
